fightSong.title: Sunny
fightSong.lyrics: Sunny place, shady plays / Miami heat for days and days / Turn the temp up, watch us burn / Sunny Place, it's our turn!

stadium.name: The Beach
stadium.tradition: The Sunscreen Spray — cheerleaders spray the first row with sunscreen pre-game. SPF 50, reef-safe.

fanCulture.description: They show up in the 3rd quarter, leave early to beat traffic, but look great doing it. After wins they go straight to South Beach.

rivalries.name: The Sunshine State
rivalries.narrative: South Florida vs west Florida. It's complicated.

cityFlavor: Sun, sand, and swagger. We don't do cold weather games.
